user_query: I'm a travel enthusiast and I'm planning a trip to South America. Can you fetch the climate data by latitude and longitude for each country in South America? Additionally, I would like to search for the mountain peaks in each country to explore hiking opportunities.

TaskList.description: Fetch the latitude and longitude for each country in South America.
Retrieve climate data for each country in South America using the fetched latitude and longitude.
Search for mountain peaks in each country in South America.
